Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 41 (Stream Data Centers missing-address campaign): added a tier-1 operator sourced campus address corroborated by a dedicated Phoenix I aggregator listing giving the identical figure, sourced and dated the companys Apollo majority acquisition (completed November 3, 2025) which the registry had previously recorded without a citable source. research_status remains complete.

[process narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Stream Data Centers was founded in 1999. This session sourced and dated the companys recent ownership change, previously recorded without a citation: per Apollo Global Managements own press releases, Apollo announced a deal to acquire a majority stake in Stream Data Centers in August 2025 and completed that acquisition on November 3, 2025, with Principal Asset Management separately acquiring a minority stake through a Principal managed fund, and Streams own management team retaining a minority stake while continuing to lead operations. The companys own site and Apollos press materials describe more than 20 to 27 campuses delivered, a 4 plus gigawatt active development pipeline, and more than 90 percent of capacity leased to Fortune 100 customers. Primary named markets include Atlanta, Chicago, Dallas-Fort Worth, Minneapolis, Phoenix, and San Antonio. This specific row, Stream Data Centers PHX-1 in Goodyear, AZ. The operators own Phoenix locations page, fetched fresh this session, describes a single 157 acre, seven building campus at 2950 S. Litchfield Road, Goodyear, Arizona 85338, with two of seven buildings complete as of that pages description and the remaining five in development, but does not break the address out per building. A dedicated PeeringDB listing specifically for Phoenix I independently gives the identical 2950 S Litchfield Rd address, corroborating that even single building listings for this campus share the one campus address rather than carrying distinguishing building specific numbers.
